tokenYojo.name: Young lady Uyuchi
tokenYojo.effect: When this little girl is destroyed, put a “Beautiful woman Uyuchi” into your hand. When this little girl comes into play from your hand, if there are already 5 or more little girls with the name “Uyuchi” in their names of the Strawberry type that you’ve played from your hand during this match, gains +3/+3 and Fast eater.
